sentences.text: On 1.27, the kubelet may be up to two minor versions older than the kube‑apiserver.

citations.quote: `kubelet` must not be newer than `kube-apiserver`, and may be up to two minor versions older.

sentences.text: On 1.31, the kubelet may be up to three minor versions older than the kube‑apiserver.

citations.quote: `kubelet` may be up to three minor versions older than `kube-apiserver` (`kubelet` < 1.25 may only be up to two minor versions older than `kube-apiserver`).
